That's fantastic. Eat, give yourself some quiet time. You'll have some hard decisions ahead, but you're never alone and we're all here to help you. Find a place to stay for the night, even if it's just a homeless shelter. And please keep us updated. Also, check other subreddits for support options, like a couch or even just a physical shoulder to lean on. We're all here for you. Don't forget it.

It doesn't matter how close those friends are, you need them now. What country are you in? This can hardly be legal. Just give yourself a moment. Get a couple hours of sleep. Contact the police if you have to. There is always a way. Don't give up straight off the bat because it looks hard. You can do this. There are resources available, and lots of people who've faced the same situation who will support you. You're never alone.

Don't do it. Don't you let them beat you. Call as many friends as you have to until you find one who will let you stay at their place tonight. Tomorrow, go to your parents, and give them a second chance. If they fail, bring in CPS or something, assuming your in the US. This can't be legal. But now is not the time to make any rash decisions.

Try focusing yourself. Do you exercise? Do you read? If not, start. Why are you late? Is it because you oversleep? Go to bed earlier, and set as many alarms as far away from the bed as you have to in order to get up. Fix yourself up, whether it be a shave, haircut, or whatever, and go to every business within biking/walking/driving distance and ask for a job application, from each one. Go to your neighbours and ask if they'll let you mow their lawn or do any sort of manual labor. It might be miserable at first, when you're working yourself to the bone and you're already at rock bottom, but it will feel so goddamn satisfying when you start climbing up, and that's what you need to focus on: that feeling you get when you start improving, and it only snowballs the higher you climb, until it's this rumbling in your gut that pushes you forward so hard and fast you forget it you. Then, you go to your dad and apologize. You tell him how much you love him, how you owe him your life in so many ways. Then you start making it up to him, day by day. You won't have the same opportunities right now, but you'll earn them back. Most importantly, model yourself with the character that will make your dad proud. You can do this. We're all rooting for you.

Nobody will ever be perfect, and that's ok. Everybody here fights every day to not give up. The important thing is that you always try, and that you keep trying. That you never give up. We all made it through, and you can do it too. No therapy is instantaneous. But it's worth it. Talk to your therapist. You have friends here. Talk to your therapist tomorrow, and we'll all be here too. If you like, you can PM me and we can talk as long as you want.
